description: Save a domain's free Porkbun-issued TLS certificate and its private key in this server's outbox, instead of returning the key. The certificate is Let's Encrypt's, provisioned for domains on Porkbun's nameservers. The files are `<domain>.fullchain.pem` (the chain) and `<domain>.privkey.pem` (the key), mode 0640 (owner and the outbox's group); the key is checked against the certificate first, and nothing is saved when it is not the certificate's. The answer gives each file's path, size and sha256, and the certificate's subject, names, issuer and validity. Install the files from there on the server that terminates TLS. This server has no outbox yet (PORKBUN_OUTBOX_DIR), so the call fails until one is set. Moves money or makes a legal document: the client asks the user to approve each call.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name registered at Porkbun, e.g. `example.com`

save_dir.description: A folder inside the outbox to save into (created if missing). Default: the outbox itself.

name: get_ssl_bundle
